subject.title: fix(secrets): surface degradation in logs and doctor

question: Should maintainers accept the final owner-isolation and redacted diagnostic behavior for secret reloads after reviewing exact-head runtime evidence?
rationale: This changes security-sensitive operational diagnostics and last-known-good reload reporting; final acceptance is a protected maintainer decision, not an automated proof substitution.

options.title: Require final-head proof before acceptance
options.body: Request one redacted built-Gateway run from the current head that demonstrates cold, stale, recovery, doctor, and identifier/value-redaction behavior.

options.title: Accept the existing earlier proof
options.body: Treat the earlier built-Gateway artifact as sufficient despite later branch changes, accepting residual uncertainty about final-head behavior.

recommendation.title: Require final-head proof before acceptance
recommendation.body: Request one redacted built-Gateway run from the current head that demonstrates cold, stale, recovery, doctor, and identifier/value-redaction behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged SecretRef owner-isolation foundation that this PR extends, making them the strongest history-backed routing candidate.
